tools.name: Street furniture
tools.description: Meters, lamps, bins, seating, parking and a furnished sidewalk.

tools.name: Rooms & apartments
tools.description: Architecture, doorway joins, profiles and generated counterexamples. Exact render review with pins.

tools.name: Furniture movement
tools.description: Walk, jump and adjust placement and collision. Reviews apply to the exact scene settings.

tools.name: Room editor
tools.description: Edit semantic fixtures and atlas overrides. Browser-local documents with JSON export/import.

tools.name: Terrain reference

tools.name: Interior catalogue

tools.name: Tiger walk demo
tools.description: Compare Blender renders with authored pixel sprites and walk in four directions.

tools.name: Pixel characters
tools.description: Inspect the animated character roster and native pixel sizes.
